capabilities: Autosuggest code block languages as you type
Add custom languages to the suggestion list
Rank suggestions by most recently used language
Bind a hotkey that opens the language suggestion modal
disambiguation: It completes only the code block's language identifier; it does not complete or write code inside the block.
problem: Obsidian offers no autocomplete for code block languages, so users must remember and type language identifiers manually each time.
summary: Autocomplete plugin that suggests code block languages from your usage history when typing a fenced code block.
